stored_value: chart_facts ashtakavarga_bindu_sign.bindus holds BENEFIC-point counts 0..8 (E0 section 3). No malefic-count row exists.
rule: A bindus operand is evaluable only when the cited passage (or its frame_citation) states the polarity of the counted points, e.g. 'benefic dots'. This map asserts NO text-wide polarity: the reviewers disagree on the BPHS rekha/bindu polarity (Grok 4.7 vs Fable 5.1, CR-006), so every text is undeclared until a verse states it. There is no 8 - n rewrite: a malefic-count verse stays quarantined. No threshold is ever supplied here.

rekha.basis: CR-006: reviewers disagree on BPHS rekha/bindu polarity; no text-wide assertion

benefic_dot.basis: the verse's own words name the points benefic
